exposure: Birth of a very low birth weight (VLBW) infant
cohort: 230 mothers and 173 fathers of VLBW and term infants recruited from three perinatal care centers in Hamburg, Germany
finding: While PTSD was rare, parents of VLBW infants experienced higher levels of posttraumatic stress symptoms and mothers had an increased risk for acute stress disorder.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was evaluated as a factor, but no specific findings related to it are mentioned.
gest_age: Infants were either very low birth weight or term, suggesting both preterm and full-term infants were included, but specific gestational age ranges are not given.
birth_weight: Infants were either very low birth weight or term
